# Getting help

- **A bug?** [Open a bug report](https://github.com/lennoxrose/ash/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **An idea?** [Open a feature request](https://github.com/lennoxrose/ash/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem?** Do not file an issue: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **How do I use it?** Start with the [README](../README.md) and the programs in
  [`examples/`](../examples). Each has its expected output next to it (`.out`).
- **Standard library questions** belong to [ash-stdlib](https://github.com/lennoxrose/ash-stdlib).

Please include `ashvm --version` (or `kiln --version`) and your OS with every report.
